title: A friendly and delicious flamenco class in Spain!
text: Great experience! 💃 The flamenco class was very nice, we learned the basics of the rhythm in a friendly atmosphere. The teacher was adorable and very educational. The wine and cheese were also very good! A very good time in Spain, I recommend it!
author: T3793CNpaulf

title: A wonderful introduction to Flamenco!
text: I really enjoyed this Flamenco workshop with Mai, focusing on Tangos. We learned the basics of palmas (rhythmic handclapping) as well as some first dance steps and a short choreography. Mai is a fantastic teacher who makes everything easy to follow and creates a relaxed, friendly atmosphere. A great experience that I would definitely recommend!
author: 901msd

title: A unique and fun experience!
text: This was a fun and unique experience for a visit to Seville! Mai was delightful and patient, guiding us through clapping and moving exercises. The class occurred in her small dance studio - great for a couple or some friends. We learned a lot about Flamenco dancing and music, and will not be able to experience it the same again. This was a highlight of our trip to Seville!
author: Lois D

title: She made us feel like family
text: Mai has the perfect personality for this experience. She chose delicious snacks for us.  She made us feel successful, even my wife who believes she's rhythm challenged. Mai is clearly a passionate artist with excellent Flemamenco skills, and we felt privileged when she did a little dancing to our rhythm clapping.
author: Samuel_M

title: Unique insight into the world of flamenco and incredibly great instructors who designed it beautifully!
text: We had a carefree, educational and beautiful evening with the instructor, the guitarist and even a dancer. We had an incredible amount of fun and would have loved to stay longer, time flew by.
author: Meander00265492193
